command:
set -euo pipefail
kubectl explain awscluster.spec.network.additionalControlPlaneIngressRules --recursive | head -45
kubectl patch awscluster managed-cluster-01 -n kcm-system --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/network/additionalControlPlaneIngressRules/-","value":{"description":"QA audit SSH","protocol":"tcp","fromPort":22,"toPort":22,"cidrBlocks":["82.64.226.65/32"]}}]'
stdout:
GROUP:      infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io
KIND:       AWSCluster
VERSION:    v1beta2

FIELD: additionalControlPlaneIngressRules <[]Object>


DESCRIPTION:
    AdditionalControlPlaneIngressRules is an optional set of ingress rules to
    add to the control plane
    IngressRule defines an AWS ingress rule for security groups.
    
FIELDS:
  cidrBlocks	<[]string>
  description	<string> -required-
  fromPort	<integer> -required-
  ipv6CidrBlocks	<[]string>
  natGatewaysIPsSource	<boolean>
  protocol	<string> -required-
  enum: -1, 4, tcp, udp, ....
  sourceSecurityGroupIds	<[]string>
  sourceSecurityGroupRoles	<[]string>
  toPort	<integer> -required-

awscluster.infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io/managed-cluster-01 patched
stderr: Warning: primary control plane load balancer is using a classic elb which is deprecated & support will be removed in a future release, please consider using another type of load balancer instead
